# `pyrite` deprecations

Version: `0.2.0`

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_cli_deprecations.py; do not edit by hand. -->

Per RFC D7 (`cli-redesign-rfc.md`), every renamed or retired `pyrite` command or option keeps its old spelling working for a minimum of 2 minor releases, warns on stderr naming the replacement, and is listed here with its removal target. See `docs/repo-design/cli/cli-reference.md` for the current command surface; regenerate this table with `python scripts/generate_cli_deprecations.py --write docs/repo-design/cli/cli-deprecations.md` or `pyrite-dev cli-deprecations`.
